intentional_differences: the ADR-006 template-learning layer of the deployed reader (stored mapping lookup, local inference, one model call under allow_ai, otherwise needs_mapping for the frontend column-confirmation dialog) is not carried over: it needs a mapping store and a confirmation UI that this platform does not have, and a half-ported version would be a shell. The consequence is written down: an unrecognised header returns stmt_headers_not_found, which is what the deployed code returned when the learning layer was not in play, instead of pretending it can hand back needs_mapping
the PDF text layer (_pdf_extract_text_safe) of the same pinned bank_table_io.py is not carried over yet: it travels with the PDF path in the next batch rather than sitting here unused

_is_summary_row and _SUMMARY_ROW_KW are not re-ported: they already live with the balance chain as bank_statement.is_summary_row over the same keyword table, and two copies of one judgement would drift apart

the deployed reader filters summary rows inline and then calls the three balance-chain helpers; this side calls bank_statement.finalize_rows, which filters and then calls the same three steps in the same order, once per account. The per-account, never-cross-account rule is unchanged

the private helpers were renamed to public entries (map_statement_columns, find_statement_header, extract_sheet_account, scan_preheader_opening, parse_statement_sheet, read_statement_workbook, header_hit, load_workbook_sheets, load_csv_sheets) because this layer is an entry point for later wiring rather than a file-internal helper; every judgement and every returned string is the deployed one
only the comments and docstrings were rewritten; the result dictionary shape, parser_version bank_recon_v2+xlsx_direct_v3 and both failure codes are the deployed ones
not_run: wiring read_statement_workbook to any caller — the third layer is only half ported and the model path does not exist yet, and a half-chain entry point would be worse than none
